prompt: The general pattern for a metal displacing another metal from its salt solution is:
options: Metal A + Metal B -> always forms an alloy
Metal A + Salt of B -> always reacts regardless of reactivity
Metal A + Salt of B -> Salt of A + Metal B, only if A is more reactive than B
Metal A + Salt of B -> Metal oxide + Salt
explanation: A metal can only displace another metal from its salt solution if the displacing metal is more reactive.
